name: Pillalamarri Banyan Tree Food Stalls
signature_dish: Snacks and refreshments at the banyan-tree site
why_it_matters: Pillalamarri — the roughly 800-year-old banyan tree spreading over three acres, about 5km from Mahbubnagar town — has only basic tourist facilities at the site: parking, a small museum and food stalls selling refreshments and snacks. The stalls are the on-site option for visitors under the tree's shade.
insider_tip: Only limited stalls operate at Pillalamarri — carry food and snacks if you want a real meal, and treat the stalls as tea-and-snacks only. For a proper meal, drive the 5km into Mahbubnagar town. Site open 8am-6pm.
signature_address: Pillalamarri Banyan Tree, Mahbubnagar town, Mahbubnagar District, Telangana 509001

name: Avanthi Hotel
why_it_matters: One of the leading hotel-restaurants in Mahbubnagar town — about 2km from the bus station and 5km from the Pillalamarri banyan tree. With an in-house coffee shop and a South-Indian restaurant, it is a popular family and meeting spot, and the practical proper-meal option for Pillalamarri visitors.
insider_tip: A Mahbubnagar town pick for the Pillalamarri trip — go here for a sit-down meal rather than relying on the banyan-tree stalls. South Indian meals and tiffins are the strength; parking can fill up. Walk-in.
signature_address: Mahbubnagar town, near bus station, Mahbubnagar District, Telangana 509001

name: Himalaya Family Restaurant
why_it_matters: A well-known central multi-cuisine restaurant in Mahbubnagar town, liked for quick service, group seating and biryani. With Pillalamarri only 5km from the town, Himalaya is one of the most reliable proper-meal options for visitors to the banyan tree.
insider_tip: A Mahbubnagar town option for the Pillalamarri trip — the biryani is the order, meals for two land around ₹350. There is a takeaway waiting hall if you want to carry food to the banyan-tree picnic shade. Walk-in.
signature_address: Padmavathi Colony, opposite State Bank, Mahbubnagar town, Mahbubnagar District, Telangana 509001

name: Ghar Dhaba
why_it_matters: A Punjabi-style highway dhaba on NH-44 at Mahbubnagar — the Hyderabad-Bengaluru corridor that runs past the Pillalamarri turn-off. Tripadvisor-listed and a long-standing road-meal halt, it is the convenient stop for anyone driving through to the banyan tree.
insider_tip: A highway dhaba — go for the Punjabi curries and tandoori roti, not fine dining. It shares the site with a fuel station, so easy parking. A practical break on the NH-44 drive to Pillalamarri.

name: Hotel 97
why_it_matters: A multi-cuisine highway hotel on NH-44 at Mahbubnagar — a Tripadvisor-listed road-meal stop on the Hyderabad-Bengaluru route near the Pillalamarri area. A straightforward option for travellers breaking the drive.
insider_tip: A standard NH-44 highway halt — covers veg meals, biryani and tiffins for a quick stop. Walk-in; ample highway parking.
